name: C-P Flexible Packaging
about:
C-P Flexible Packaging operates a manufacturing plant in Lakeville, Minnesota, just south of Minneapolis, with its corporate headquarters in York, Pennsylvania. The company's Lakeville facility serves as a production hub for custom flexible packaging solutions.

The Lakeville plant specializes in creating custom packaging tailored to customer performance and aesthetic requirements, with an emphasis on designs that run efficiently on existing packaging equipment. Its product range includes compostable lidding, die-cut rollstock, and a variety of premade pouches. The company does not disclose facility size, headcount, or annual volumes on its website.

The company's website lists a "Markets" section but does not specify served industries on the Lakeville location page. Navigation suggests focus areas may include technology and sustainability, though concrete customer types or industry examples are not provided in the available content.

C-P Flexible Packaging positions its differentiation on the ability to deliver packaging that meets both performance and aesthetic needs while ensuring compatibility with the customer's packaging lines. The company highlights its readiness to supply compostable lidding, die-cut rollstock, and premade pouches as part of its custom packaging offerings.
